description: This file defines the core logic for the onboarding wizard in a macOS application, including a view model class managing wizard state, and a SwiftUI view for rendering individual wizard steps with various input types. It interacts with external services for starting, submitting, and cancelling wizard sessions and handles decoding and encoding data across different parts of the application.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: Observable class managing the onboarding wizard's session state, handling start, submit, and cancel operations, including error handling and session recovery.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardStepView
classes.description: SwiftUI view rendering a form for a specific wizard step, supporting different input types and submission handling.

classes.name: WizardOptionItem
classes.description: Simple identifiable struct representing an option in select/multiselect wizard steps.

methods.name: bridgeToLocal
methods.description: Converts a ProtocolAnyCodable to a local AnyCodable, decoding via JSON to avoid type conflicts.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates wizard session if not already started, setting up communication with backend and handling errors.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a user's response for the current wizard step asynchronously.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing wizard session if it is currently active.

methods.name: applyStartResult
methods.description: Updates the model's state based on the start result response from backend.

methods.name: applyNextResult
methods.description: Updates the model's state based on the response after submitting a step.

methods.name: applyStatusResult
methods.description: Updates the model's status based on the wizard status response.

methods.name: restartIfSessionLost
methods.description: Attempts to restart the wizard session if it was lost, based on error code and message.

methods.name: shouldSkipWizard
methods.description: Determines whether the wizard should be skipped based on configuration data.
